Professional Summary
Detail-oriented QA Automation Engineer with a strong track record in designing and executing automated test frameworks, improving test coverage, and integrating automation into CI pipelines. Proven experience delivering reliable test suites and reducing regression time through Selenium- and pytest-based solutions.

Technical Skills
Selenium, Automation Testing, Jenkins, pytest, JUnit, Linux, Git, Confluence

Work Experience

QA Automation Engineer, Saffron Bank (Aug 2024 - Present)
- Developed and maintained Selenium-based automated test suites for core banking web applications, improving regression coverage for critical workflows by implementing reusable page objects and test utilities. (Selenium, Automation Testing, pytest)
- Integrated pytest test runs with Jenkins to enable nightly pipeline execution and email reporting, reducing manual regression execution time by automating end-to-end checks. (Jenkins, pytest, Selenium)
- Collaborated with developers and product owners via Confluence to document test plans, release checklists, and defect triage, ensuring visibility of automation metrics and test results. (Confluence, Git, Linux)

Test Engineer, Zoho (Mar 2021 - Jul 2024)
- Implemented pytest and JUnit test cases for web and API layers, standardizing test patterns and increasing automated test pass rates across releases. (pytest, JUnit, Automation Testing)
- Built Selenium scripts for cross-browser UI validation and integrated them into Jenkins pipelines for continuous validation, leading to earlier detection of UI regressions. (Selenium, Jenkins, Automation Testing)
- Managed test repositories and CI configurations using Git and Linux-based runners, and maintained test documentation and runbooks in Confluence to streamline onboarding and incident response. (Git, Linux, Confluence)
